tasks.title: Validate v2.4 migration under load
tasks.description: Re-run the migration dry-run with a synthetic concurrent write workload.

comments.body:
**Dry-run evidence — migration timeout issue**

Ran multiple dry-runs over the weekend against a prod-sized snapshot. Observed intermittent timeouts ~1 in 5 runs (roughly 20% failure rate) when concurrent write load is applied during the migration.

**Root cause hypothesis:** The `events.workspace_id_idx` index is missing during the table-rewrite pass. Without it, the rewrite triggers full-table scans under concurrent writes, causing lock contention and eventual statement timeout.

**Reproduction:** Timeouts are load-dependent — they don't appear in low-traffic dry-runs, only when simulating concurrent write load (similar to prod peak).

**Query plan:** The slow pass shows a Seq Scan on `events` where an Index Scan on `workspace_id_idx` would be expected. I can share the full EXPLAIN ANALYZE output if helpful — just let me know, Kai.

Recommend we do not deploy until this index is confirmed present before the rewrite step.
